label: Claude Opus 5.5
output:
To: @renee.whitlock
Replying to: [s01]
Cc: none
Subject: none

Morning Renee, here's my rundown for the admin meeting. Use whatever helps.

GAME
We beat Brookhollow 31-14 Friday, and that locks us into 2nd in the region.

- Deshawn Pettaway had 3 sacks and 7 tackles. The kids voted him defensive player of the week in the locker room before us coaches even got together. That tells you what his teammates think of him.
- Tavion Hurst ran for 188 yards and 2 TDs. His long TD came in the 3rd quarter, and our line pushed them 5 yards back on that whole drive. Best I've seen them block all year.
- Our defense held them to 46 yards rushing in the second half.

PLAYOFFS
We got a HOME playoff game. We host Clanton Valley in the first round this Friday, Nov 13, 7pm at Ridge Field. Ticket presale starts Tuesday. Please make sure Dr. Pruitt knows, and push it however y'all can. We want folks to come out and pack it. Boosters are looking for 6 more people to work concessions, and a sign up sheet is going out.

ACADEMICS
The 9 week grade check is in and all 52 kids on the roster are eligible. Nobody is on the list. That's on Tonya Greer, not me. Her study hall on Tuesdays and Thursdays is the reason the grades are clean, and she's keeping it going through the playoffs. If anybody's getting a shout out in the board report I'd really like it to be her.

BOOSTERS
The Boston butt sale is final. Carla Mims and the booster club sold 208 butts and raised $6,240. The goal was $4,500. That money is going toward new sideline headsets. Hargrove's Meat Market did all the smoking at cost, so they deserve a thank you too.

BUSES
I know transportation needs bus requests 5 days out for away playoff games. If we win Friday and go on the road for round 2, I'll get the bus info to you as soon as we know where we're headed.

Let me know if you need anything else before noon.

Coach Tillman
